name: T3MA
summary: This EA uses the T3 Moving Average indicator to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long positions when the T3 MA rises and short positions when it falls, typically using crossover or slope-change logic. The strategy is a systematic trend-following system based on the smoothed T3 MA to reduce noise and lag compared to standard moving averages.
summary_zh: 该EA使用T3移动平均线指标生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当T3均线上升时做多，下降时做空，通常使用交叉或斜率变化逻辑。该策略是基于平滑T3均线的系统化趋势跟踪系统，旨在减少噪声和滞后。
strategy_analysis: T3MA策略基于T3移动平均线指标，该指标由Tillson开发，通过多重指数移动平均的平滑处理来减少价格噪声和信号滞后。入场条件通常为T3均线的斜率变化或方向反转——当均线从下降转为上升时开多单，从上升转为下降时开空单。出场条件可能包括反向信号出现时平仓，或结合止损止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA通常支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的比例仓位计算。资金管理方面，参数中包含止损和止盈设置，但具体的风险控制力度取决于参数配置。该策略的核心优势在于T3均线的平滑性减少了虚假信号，但在震荡行情中仍可能产生频繁的反复开平仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The T3MA strategy is based on the T3 Moving Average indicator developed by Tillson, which uses multiple exponential moving average smoothing passes to reduce price noise and signal lag. Entry conditions typically rely on the slope change or direction reversal of the T3 MA — opening long positions when the MA turns from declining to rising, and short positions when it turns from rising to declining. Exit conditions may include closing positions on opposite signals or using predefined stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing typically supports fixed lot trading, with some versions including proportional lot calculation based on account balance. Money management includes stop-loss and take-profit parameters, though the actual risk control effectiveness depends on parameter configuration. The core advantage is the T3 MA's smoothness reducing false signals, but it can still generate frequent whipsaw trades in ranging markets.

parameters.description_en: T3 MA volume factor, controls smoothing

parameters.name: Stop_Loss

parameters.name: Take_Profit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

pros: T3均线相比普通MA具有更强的平滑性，减少虚假信号
策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调优
趋势行情中表现良好，能够捕捉中期趋势
pros_en: T3 MA provides superior smoothness compared to standard MAs, reducing false signals
Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and optimize
Performs well in trending markets, capable of capturing medium-term trends
cons: 震荡行情中容易产生频繁的反复信号导致连续亏损
均线类策略固有滞后性，入场和出场可能不够及时
缺乏多时间框架确认和额外过滤条件，信号质量有限
cons_en: Prone to frequent whipsaw signals and consecutive losses in ranging/sideways markets
Inherent lag of moving average strategies may cause late entries and exits
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and additional filters, limiting signal quality
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，例如高一级周期趋势方向过滤
加入ATR动态止损止盈和波动率过滤，避免在低波动震荡市中频繁交易
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, e.g., higher timeframe trend direction filter
Incorporate ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit and volatility filter to avoid frequent trading in low-volatility ranging markets

risk_points: 默认止损止盈可能为0，存在无限亏损风险
缺乏仓位检查和新K线检查，可能重复开仓
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能持续亏损
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit may be zero, creating unlimited loss risk
Lacks position check and new bar check, potentially opening duplicate positions
Trend-following strategy can sustain continuous losses in ranging markets
